description: Hi! I'm Chaîmae, a physics graduate with 2 years of experience teaching math. I love space education and explaining science simply. Our team is working on "Abandoned but not Forgotten": telling the stories of NASA's hardware left on the Moon and Mars for school-age learners. Looking for teammates for illustration/design, digital storytelling (book, video or podcast) or a simple website. No expert level needed, just curiosity. We will work online.
summary:
Our project is a short storytelling video about NASA's Opportunity rover, the little robot that was sent to Mars for only 90 days and survived for almost 15 years.

We developed a video that tells Opportunity's journey in a simple and emotional way, from its landing on Mars in 2004, to its discovery of evidence of ancient water, to driving more than 45 kilometers, and finally to its last message during the global dust storm in 2018.

Our project addresses the challenge by making real NASA data accessible to everyone, especially young people. Instead of complex scientific reports, we use storytelling, real NASA images, and clear facts to show why Opportunity matters.

It is important because Opportunity proves that curiosity, resilience, and exploration can go far beyond expectations, and it inspires the next generation to love space and science.
details: We used Canva to design and animate the video, add text, images, and transitions. We used real NASA images and information from NASA websites for accuracy. We used Claude (Super Intelligence) to help us organize the script, correct the English, and make the scientific information simple and clear. The final story, the choice of scenes, and the editing were all decided by our team.
